mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_follow (user_id, follow_user_id, status, follow_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{followUserId}, 1, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = 1, follow_time = NOW()
mapper.select:
SELECT f.id AS follow_id, f.follow_user_id AS user_id, u.username AS username, u.nickname AS nickname, COALESCE(u.avatar_url, '') AS avatar_url, f.follow_time AS followed_at FROM user_follow f INNER JOIN `user` u ON u.id = f.follow_user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0
f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.status = 1
AND ( f.follow_time < #{cursorFollowTime} OR (f.follow_time = #{cursorFollowTime} AND f.id < #{cursorId}) )
ORDER BY f.follow_time DESC, f.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
